purpose: The walk follows notable wallets whose record can be checked.
rule: Rank every address by what official Uniswap venues (the v4 PoolManager and the pools of the official v3 factory) sent it of the Stock Tokens that have a Chainlink feed, in the window, directly or through a listed router in the same transaction, each transfer at the feed's value at its block. From the top: a router or another contract is not a wallet and is listed as such without asking; every other address is asked about once on vet402's free route. An address it can build a record for is selected. Any other is listed with the reason and not walked. Stop at the number to select, or at the number of addresses asked.
purchase: Within one transaction a wallet bought a token when an official venue emitted a swap log and sent the token, the wallet ended the transaction with more of it, the wallet itself paid USDG or WETH or (as the signer) ETH, no liquidity log is in the transaction, and no other Stock Token left the wallet.
price_source: AnswerUpdated logs of the feed's aggregator: the last answer at or before the block, the last in log order within a block. The public RPC keeps no historical state, so latestRoundData() cannot be asked at a past block.
